subject: c-cont
title: C.CONT.------TR.
description: Chart on book p. 49 (WM-25). The chart has no arrow; C-CONT (composite continuance), the first title code, is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; TR (transformation) is the partner. The main line from the subject bends at T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) and runs on to TR. From the subject: T-C-IMP. From T-C-IMP: the partner TR and PHY-U-P (physical universe particular); A-PROJ is on a dotted line from T-C-IMP. From PHY-U-P: C-INFO (composite information). From C-INFO: GRAD (gradualism) and PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics). From PROJ-DY: CULT-TF-S. From TR: POL-P (political policies). From POL-P: INFO-DS (information dissemination) and AFN (affinity negation). ATTN (attraction), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of", is on a dotted line from AFN.
